method: Systematic square counting on traced line segments
steps: Traced lines: top-left square with inscribed diamond, outer frame 290x252 (a rectangle), inner step grid of five 55px cells
Axis squares: top-left square, its overlap corner with the frame, the top-left box inside frame (110x97, taken as square)
Grid: 5 unit cells, one 2x2 block, three 110px squares (upper right, lower right, lower middle-left)
Plus the inscribed diamond; outer frame excluded as clearly rectangular

method: Mirror image across a vertical mirror (left-right reversal)
steps: Mirror MN is vertical on the right, so order reverses and each glyph flips left-right: L k 4 A e R y
A: A is turned upside down (inverted), fails
D: glyphs not reversed correctly (4, A, e left as normal), fails
C: last glyph is y turned upside down (vertical flip), fails
B: reversed L, k, 4, A, mirrored e, mirrored R and y with its tail continuing to the lower right: correct
